content.title: Retirement Plan Board (CARP)
content.summary: The City of Arvada Retirement Plan Board (CARP) oversees the city's retirement plan and consists of five members serving four-year terms. Meetings are held at 11:00 am on the second Thursday of February, May, August, and November in the City Council Room at City Hall. Recruitment for board vacancies will begin in December, and interested candidates must be registered voters in Arvada.
content.body:
## Overview

The City of Arvada Retirement Plan Board (CARP) is responsible for overseeing the administration of the City's retirement plan.

## Meetings

- 11:00 am
- 2nd Thursday of the second month of each quarter
- City Council Room (CCR)  
  City Hall  
  8101 Ralston Road

## Board Details

- 5 members
- 4 year terms
- Volunteer appointment
- Must be registered to vote in Arvada to serve

## Interested in Joining the Retirement Plan Board?

Recruitment to fill vacancies on boards and commissions will begin in December. You can review the application process on the main [Boards, Commissions and Committees page](/248/Boards-Commissions-and-Committees).
